paragraphs.text: 1. To thee will send praise and bring oblation, as thou hast merited lauds when we invoked thee.
paragraphs.original: प्र ते यक्षि प्र त इयर्मि मन्म भुवो यथा वन्द्यो नो हवेषु ।
paragraphs.translit: pra te yakṣi pra ta iyarmi manma bhuvo yathā vandyo no haveṣu |

paragraphs.text: A fountain in the desert art thou, Agni, O Ancient King, to man who fain would worship,
paragraphs.original: धन्वन्निव प्रपा असि त्वमग्न इयक्षवे पूरवे प्रत्न राजन्
paragraphs.translit: dhanvanniva prapā asi tvamagna iyakṣave pūrave pratna rājan

paragraphs.text: 2. Thou unto whom resort the gathered people, as the kine seek the warm stall, O Most Youthful.
paragraphs.original: यं त्वा जनासो अभि संचरन्ति गाव उष्णमिव व्रजं यविष्ठ ।
paragraphs.translit: yaṃ tvā janāso abhi saṃcaranti gāva uṣṇamiva vrajaṃ yaviṣṭha |

paragraphs.text: Thou art the messenger of Gods and mortals, and goest glorious with thy light between them.
3. Making thee grow as 'twere some noble infant, thy Mother nurtures thee with sweet affection.
paragraphs.original: शिशुं न त्वा जेन्यं वर्धयन्ती माता बिभर्ति सचनस्यमाना ।
paragraphs.translit: śiśuṃ na tvā jenyaṃ vardhayantī mātā bibharti sacanasyamānā |

paragraphs.text: Over the desert slopes thou passest longing, and seekest, like some beast set free, thy fodder.
4. Foolish are we, O Wise and free from error: verily, Agni, thou dost know thy grandeur.
paragraphs.original: मूरा अमूर न वयं चिकित्वो महित्वमग्ने त्वमङ्ग वित्से ।
paragraphs.translit: mūrā amūra na vayaṃ cikitvo mahitvamagne tvamaṅga vitse |

paragraphs.text: There lies the form: he moves and licks, and swallows, and, as House-Lord, kisses the Youthful Maiden.
paragraphs.original: शये वव्रिश्चरति जिह्वयादन्रेरिह्यते युवतिं विश्पतिः सन्
paragraphs.translit: śaye vavriścarati jihvayādanrerihyate yuvatiṃ viśpatiḥ san

paragraphs.text: 5. He rises ever fresh in ancient fuel: smoke-bannered, gray, he makes the wood his dwelling.
paragraphs.original: कूचिज्जायते सनयासु नव्यो वने तस्थौ पलितो धूमकेतुः ।
paragraphs.translit: kūcijjāyate sanayāsu navyo vane tasthau palito dhūmaketuḥ |

paragraphs.text: No swimmer, Steer, he presses through the waters, and to his place accordant mortals bear him.
paragraphs.original: अस्नातापो वृषभो न प्र वेति सचेतसो यं प्रणयन्त मर्ताः
paragraphs.translit: asnātāpo vṛṣabho na pra veti sacetaso yaṃ praṇayanta martāḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. Like thieves who risk their lives and haunt the forest, the twain with their ten girdles have secured him.
This is a new hymn meant for thee, O Agni: yoke as it were thy car with parts that glitter.
paragraphs.original: इयं ते अग्ने नव्यसी मनीषा युक्ष्वा रथं न शुचयद्भिरङ्गैः
paragraphs.translit: iyaṃ te agne navyasī manīṣā yukṣvā rathaṃ na śucayadbhiraṅgaiḥ

paragraphs.text: 7. Homage and prayer are thine, O Jatavedas, and this my song shall evermore exalt thee.
paragraphs.original: ब्रह्म च ते जातवेदो नमश्चेयं च गीः सदमिद्वर्धनी भूत् ।
paragraphs.translit: brahma ca te jātavedo namaśceyaṃ ca gīḥ sadamidvardhanī bhūt |

paragraphs.text: Agni, protect our children and descendants, and guard with ever-watchful care our bodies.
paragraphs.original: रक्षा णो अग्ने तनयानि तोका रक्षोत नस्तन्वो अप्रयुच्छन्
paragraphs.translit: rakṣā ṇo agne tanayāni tokā rakṣota nastanvo aprayucchan
